// 查 our-free-model 的仓库来源（上一步没输出它）+ openviking state 大小
const r = await tools.pwsh({
  command: `
Write-Host '=== our-free-model package.json ==='
$p = "$env:DSH_HOME\\profiles\\desktop\\node_modules\\dsh-our-free-model\\package.json"
$j = Get-Content $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
"version: " + $j.version
"repository: " + ($j.repository | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
Write-Host '=== openviking state 内容 ==='
Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.openviking" -Recurse -Depth 2 | Select-Object FullName, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
Write-Host '=== sessions 目录 ==='
(Get-ChildItem "$env:DSH_HOME\\sessions" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
Write-Host '=== grill-first 记忆目录 ==='
Get-ChildItem "$env:DSH_HOME\\grill-first" -Recurse -Depth 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String
`,
  description: "核对 our-free-model 来源与 openviking 状态"
});
console.log(r.stdout);
tool_input.description: 核对剩余插件来源与状态目录
